local: God bless our motherland [[Ghana]]
And make our nation great and strong,
Bold to defend forever
The cause of Freedom and of Right;
english: God bless our motherland [[Ghana]]
And make our nation great and strong,
Bold to defend forever
The cause of Freedom and of Right;

local: Fill our hearts with true humility,
Make us cherish fearless honesty,
And help us to resist oppressors' rule
With all our will and might for evermore.
english: Fill our hearts with true humility,
Make us cherish fearless honesty,
And help us to resist oppressors' rule
With all our will and might for evermore.

local: Hail to thy name, O [[Ghana]],
To thee we make our solemn vow:
Steadfast to build together
A nation strong in Unity;
english: Hail to thy name, O [[Ghana]],
To thee we make our solemn vow:
Steadfast to build together
A nation strong in Unity;

local: With our gifts of mind and strength of arm,
Whether night or day, in mist or storm,
In every need, whate'er the call may be,
To serve thee, [[Ghana]], now and for evermore.
english: With our gifts of mind and strength of arm,
Whether night or day, in mist or storm,
In every need, whate'er the call may be,
To serve thee, [[Ghana]], now and for evermore.

local: Raise high the flag of [[Ghana]]
and one with Africa advance;
Black star of hope and honour
To all who thirst for liberty;
english: Raise high the flag of [[Ghana]]
and one with Africa advance;
Black star of hope and honour
To all who thirst for liberty;

local: Where the banner of [[Ghana]] freely flies,
May the way to freedom truly lie;
Arise, arise, O sons of [[Ghana]] land,
And under God march on for evermore!
english: Where the banner of [[Ghana]] freely flies,
May the way to freedom truly lie;
Arise, arise, O sons of [[Ghana]] land,
And under God march on for evermore!
